cohort: The study included 391 women with primary stress urinary incontinence treated with either tension-free vaginal tape (TVT) or polyacrylamide hydrogel (PAHG) injection.
finding: After a 2-year follow-up, PAHG was associated with a higher likelihood of requiring re-treatment (27.0% vs 0.9% for TVT), while overall complication rates were similar, and TVT carried a greater risk of severe complications.
